resources.string: Replace the selected text as soon as the first result arrives. Turn off to preview the result first.
Type or paste text, select it, and pick Paraphrase from the popup — or use the button below.

1. Long-press any text in any app (WhatsApp, Gmail, Chrome, notes…).
2. Drag the handles to select what you want rewritten.
3. Tap Paraphrase in the popup toolbar. If you don't see it, tap the ⋮ overflow at the end of the toolbar.
4. The selection is replaced with the rewritten text.

In read-only text (web pages, chat bubbles you can't edit) the result is shown and copied to the clipboard instead.
No API key set — open Paraphase and add a free key. Using the basic on-device rewriter for now.
Rewrite any text, right where you typed it.
Select text in any app, tap Paraphrase, and the words are replaced in place. No copy-paste, no switching keyboards.
